title: Room Processing Checklist
description: Internal reference for Forever Furniture cabinet shop staff: what to check and what notes to enter in Cabinet Vision when processing a room.

glossary.meaning: Top / Bottom / Left / Right (used in reveal notation)

entries.rule: Double-check that nothing will hit appliance handles and that all drawers in corners will open clear and not hit anything (farm sinks!). Are fillers big enough for appliance/cabinet doors to clear house casings?
Add Cabinet Notes in Cabinet Vision by right-clicking on a cabinet and choosing the Comments tab.
Add notes for a sub-assembly part by clicking the Reports tab from within the cabinet editor, then Order Entry (on the left).

sections.name: Room Notes
sections.description: Room Properties > Room > Notes tab. Affects all order forms.

entries.rule: Alpha Grain Direction.
Custom * Profile - will REPLACE the room's selected profiles on the Door Order Form.
Door/DF Edgeband - "MATCH" or specify the banding if known ahead of time.
Edgeband Alert? (N or Y) - Y adds the edgeband alert near the top of the Main Shipping List in red. Edgeband Alert Text is the text displayed (not shown if Alert? is N).
Face Frame (N or Y) - Y adds "- FACE FRAME" to the room name on all reports and notes on ProBox Order Form.
Room Box Material (1, 2, 3) - "WHITE MELAMINE" or specify a different material. Split into 3 boxes in room notes for spacing purposes on the title block; all 3 combine on the reports.
Room Drawer Assembly/Finish - "WALNUT" or any custom drawer box material (ProBox Order Form).
Room Drawer Material (1, 2) - "BALTIC BIRCH" or any drawer box material; 1 & 2 combine on the reports.
Room Edge Type - (P) PVC (standard), (V) Veneer, (O) Other.
Room Edgeband - "ALPHA'S CHOICE" or specify the banding if known ahead of time. Black Melamine box material should have "BLACK" edge banding.
Room Finish Extra - anything typed here combines with the finish on the title block and reports.
Room Material Extra - anything typed here combines with the wood on the title block and reports.
Box Material if not room default (usually for a finished-interior cabinet).
All non-sink/cooktop Base Cabinets need a full top note.
If Face Frame (ff): if the whole room is FF, make sure Face Frame is marked "Y" in Room Notes ("N" for Euro).
Bases & Talls in Face Frame rooms: deck height note (with supports). FF rail height minus half of deck (1 1/2 - 3/8 = 1 1/8).
Reveals (RV's) if different from standard (Top, Bottom, Left, Right).
Standard Euro reveals by cabinet type.
Euro base cabinets below a shop-built wood top.
Standard Face Frame reveals by cabinet type.
Face Frame Hanging Base Units.
Pencil Drawers (Euro or Face Frame).
entries.example:
full top
RV's (1/4" T, 0" B, 1/16" L & R)
no deck

entries.rule: Back Thickness - inset or applied? Standard is 1/4" with dados.
Blind Corner Cabinet - make sure to include a flat filler as a separate part number. Include the door width and blind width.
Sink Cabinets - apron height.

Vertical Partitions (pt) or Double Partitions (dbl pt) - cabinet width > 36" will need a pt (or nosing on shelves). Dimension to center (oc) of pt from Left or Right of cabinet box exterior. Note per section: Left Sec (...), Right Sec (...).

Fixed Shelves (fs). Euro: fs usually splits space between 2 vertical doors/drawer fronts. Face Frame: behind horizontal face frames, the top edge lines up with the top of the face frame rail. Dimension from bottom of box to center (oc) of fixed shelf.
Fixed shelves: banding is standard on Euro cabinets. If hidden behind face frame, note no banding.
Ovens usually need to sit on a double fixed shelf to support weight.
For Each Section between Fixed Shelves (or the only section if none): note per section.
entries.example: Top Sec (...), Mid Sec (...), Mid Btm Sec (...), Btm Sec (...), etc.

entries.rule: Doors or Drawer Fronts (DF's) or No Doors? Hinge Plate Holes (standard) or No Hinge Plate Holes. If No Doors: appliance? open? back or no back?
Line Bore (standard, holes for adjustable shelves) or No Line Bore?
Quantity of Adjustable Shelves (approx. 12" between each).
Adjustable shelf banding is standard. If shop will add nosing instead, note it. If not hardwood, add depth for cut & fold nosing.
entries.example:
no banding - add 1 1/2" nosing
+2" as depth - FF to cut & fold for 1 1/2" nosing

entries.rule: Quantity & depth of drawers (drw) / Roll-outs (ro) per section.
Hinge side if one door.
Check hinge bore note on Alpha confirmation & update notes if not 4".
Flipper Door Outer Cabinet: top RV for doors to clear; standard deck, deck up note, or no deck; comment/note for no line bore/no hinge plate holes.
entries.example: RV's (13/16" T); deck up 1 1/8" or no deck; NLB, NPH (No Doors)

entries.rule: Flipper Door Inner Cabinet (sits inside outer cabinet): width is 4" narrower than the outer box interior opening width; height matches outer box interior opening height; depth is 1 1/4" less than outer box exterior (1" for back, 1/4" for front so flipper hinges clear); inner box has a finished interior.
Cabinets with Finished Ends: note dowel front hole side, assuming the back of the cabinet will not be visible (confirmat construction).
entries.example: fl/dowel front hole OR fr/dowel front hole

entries.rule: Double-check ALL doors and panels - do they have mid rails (MR) or mid stiles (MS)? Mesh or glass panels need a sash note.
entries.example: sash panel for glass or sash panel for mesh

entries.rule: EACH door/panel needs Top Rail (TR), Bottom Rail (BR), Left Stile (LS), Right Stile (RS) dimensions if different from room standard, plus a note for MR/MS placement on center from the edge of the door.
MR/MS are generally wider than the outside stiles & rails by the width of one molding profile.
entries.example: On a 3" S&R door, 3 5/8" MR up 31 1/2" oc (if the inside profile is 5/8" wide)

entries.rule: 5-Piece Glass/Mesh Panel Doors MUST have a minimum of 2 1/2" stiles & rails.
Slab Doors/DF's with outside molding should be ordered as veneer panels.
For Face Frame Cabinets with Doors/DF's that do NOT have square outside edges - PAIR & SINGLE DOORS & DF's: size must be 3/16" smaller than the face frame opening in height.
entries.example: For Cabinet Vision: -3/32" overlays for top & bottom

entries.rule: PAIR DOORS: overall size must be 1/4" smaller than the face frame opening in width.
entries.example: For Cabinet Vision: -1/8" overlays for left & right

entries.rule: SINGLE DOORS & DRAWER FRONTS: size must be 3/16" smaller than the face frame opening in width.
entries.example: For Cabinet Vision: -3/32" overlays for left & right

entries.rule: For a Single Euro Cabinet captured between any combo of End Panels & Fillers - gaps between pair doors need 1/4" overall (1/8" between doors + Left & Right reveals).
entries.example: For Cabinet Vision: 1/16" Left & Right reveals; if End Panels/T-fillers cover front edges of cabinets, reveals are 13/16"

entries.rule: Single doors/drawer fronts need 3/16" overall (Left + Right reveals).
entries.example: For Cabinet Vision: 3/32" Left & Right reveals; if End Panels/T-fillers cover front edges of cabinets, reveals are 27/32"

entries.rule: Typically use Blum Soft-close Slides; heavy-duty drawers/roll-outs need Accuride 3832 (or 4034 for really heavy-duty).

CV drawer width & depth are determined by Room Properties > Cabinet > Hardware > Drawer Guide Schedule. Choose ONLY schedules that have 'No Notch' at the end of their names. Also change Properties > Cabinet > Construction > Drawer Box/Roll Outs to match the selected guide.
entries.example: FFI Blum No Dovetail or FFI Accuride No Dovetail

entries.rule: If Drawer Box < 15" deep AND DF > 5 7/8" tall - use Accuride Slides for that drawer only.
File Drawers (DF at least 13" tall, 10 1/4" tall drawer box) need Accuride 3832 (NOT soft-close).
File Drawers wider than 24" need Accuride 4034 (NOT soft-close).
Drawer Fronts that are the same height (per cabinet) should have drawer boxes that are the same height.
Add Drw/RO notes in Cabinet Vision by clicking on the "drw box sub-front" or "ro sub-front" and adding a comment.
Drawers in FF boxes need "Adjustable Clips" (FF rooms get this by default; does not apply to ROs).
Drawers in Euro boxes need "Standard Clips" (Euro rooms get this by default; does not apply to ROs).
Cabinets different from the room standard need a note on EACH drawer (check the ProBox report, should be automatic).
ANY SINK CABINET WITH A RO - the RO depth should be 3" less than standard (to allow for plumbing at back). Drawers in a sink cabinet should get a note to notch around plumbing.
Drawer Fronts wider than 36" - cabinet box note needs drawer stabilizers.
Pre-finished Maple EURO Cabinets - drawers will be 1/16" wider than usual.
entries.example: FFI Blum - Euro, Prefin Maple Cabinet - No Notch OR Accuride 3832 - Maple Cab - No Notch

entries.rule: Charging Drawers - minimum 2" clearance behind drawer box (order drawer box 1 size down if necessary).
Euro Wall - Fillers & End Panels should be 1/8" taller than box (for 1/8" bottom overhang).
Will the filler be "L-shape", "U-shape", "T-shape", "C-shape", "J-shape", or something else?
Fillers next to appliances should match toekick.
Face Frame Wall - End Panels should be 3/4" taller than box (for 3/4" bottom overhang).
Will need scribe if touching a wall or the floor (typically 1/2"). End panels with scribe need to widen the stiles (Left, Right) and/or rails (Top, Bottom) that touch the wall/floor.
entries.example: 3 1/2" Left Stile => 3 1/2" LS; 7 1/2" Bottom Rail => 7 1/2" BR

entries.rule: Anything with the phrase "End Panel" will have its width and depth reversed on Cabinet Vision reports.
T-Fillers - add note to cabinet boxes that the filler covers.
entries.example: FF to rabbet sides for T-filler, FF to rabbet left side for T-filler, or FF to rabbet top and bottom for T-filler

entries.rule: End Panels ordered from Stillwater - note not to sand edges.
END PANELS INSET IN FACE FRAMES (usually Doran Taylor jobs) - Paint Grade: regular, full-size end panels; order stiles & rails wider to be kerfed to appear as face frame.
entries.example: do not sand edges - 4 1/2" S&R - 7 1/2" MR up 31 1/4" oc

entries.rule: END PANELS INSET IN FACE FRAMES - NOT Paint Grade: panels to be 1/8" wider & 1/8" taller than face frame opening, S&R to match doors.
24" deep cabinet, 18"-23 7/8" in width shall have a 22" deep trash drawer (ROT).
24" wide cabinet shall have 21" deep ROT, standard bottom (up 1/2").
26" or greater deep cabinet shall have a 24" deep ROT, standard bottom (up 1/2").
24" deep cabinet, less than 18" wide shall have a 21" deep ROT, standard bottom (up 1/2").
22" deep trash drawer shall have bottom up 1 3/4" (to allow modification for 21" Blum soft-close slides).
6 1/4" tall drawer box, minimum 15" x 22" (w x d or d x w) - roll-out placed near top of door.
Minimum 11" clear below drawer box.
In-cabinet lighting note for recessed aluminum LED track.
entries.example: FF to recess aluminum track for LEDs

entries.rule: Include scribe as part of stile or rail dimensions (when 1 1/2" will be visible after install).
Outside stiles that miter to end panels or other face frames are actually 1 9/16".
Inside overhang CAN be different on the same open cabinet because it's not noticeable.

Face Frame should be proportional to the size of the bookcase. Preferred 2" minimum on bookcases (if NO door/drawers) to have 1/4" inside overhangs; bigger overhangs (usually 3/4"-1") if there will be LEDs.
1 1/2" face frames if the cabinet also has doors or drawers that line up with the bookcase openings.
Depth on a 24" deep base cabinet (typically a 3/4" overhang on all finished sides).
entries.example: Backs wall WITH scribe - 26 1/8" deep; backs wall WITHOUT scribe - 25 5/8" deep

entries.rule: Cabinets directly below wood tops should have a top reveal note.
Cabinets that die into a corner cabinet get L-fillers; the corner cabinet gets 2 L-fillers to be mitered on site. Should be 4 fillers total if cabinets on 2 walls die into the corner cabinet.
Adjustable Shelves AND rods?
Fixed rods - approx. 40" from deck of shelf to rod center for most people's clothes to fit without dragging.

sections.name: Custom Cabinet Names
sections.description: These will alter if a cabinet shows up on Cabinet Vision Reports.

entries.rule: NOCO - Not On Cabinet Order.
NOCO NOSIZE - Not On Cabinet Order, size will not show.
NOSIZE - add to any cabinet name and size will not show.
NOAL - Not On Any List.
RAS - Rev-A-Shelf (will not show up on Cabinet Order).
HAFELE - Hafele (will not show up on Cabinet Order).

5-piece Doors & DF's: Doors & DF's from Stillwater (if wire-brushed, order all UNASSEMBLED - wire-brushing done in-house; note 'WIRE BRUSHED' on report headers). Fillers, Slab End Panels, Floating Shelves, Toe Kick, Top Mold are Shop-Built.
Slab - Textured Melamine: Doors & DF's from Alpha; Fillers, End Panels, Floating Shelves, Toe Kick (rips), Top Mold (rips) from Alpha.
Slab - Veneer - Wire Brushed: Doors & DF's from Alpha (note 'WIRE BRUSHED' on report headers); Fillers, End Panels, Floating Shelves, Top Mold (rips) from Alpha; Toe Kick Shop-Built.
Slab - Veneer: Vertical Grain OR Horizontal Grain: Doors & DF's from Alpha; Fillers, End Panels, Floating Shelves, Top Mold (rips) from Alpha; Toe Kick Shop-Built.
Slab - Paint Grade: Doors & DF's from Alpha; Fillers, End Panels (with nosing), Floating Shelves, Toe Kick, Top Mold Shop-Built; Slab End Panels (3/4" thick, with banding) from Alpha.
Parts ordered from Alpha may require selecting "Get from Alpha" in the Cabinet Vision part attribute.
Textured Melamine, Laminate, Slab Veneer, etc. (slab, sheet-goods stuff) - choose "SLAB - MDF CORE" as the Door Style (Room Properties > Cabinet > Doors).
Note for Fillers: "band 2w, 1h" (band 2 widths, 1 height). For L-shape fillers, note cut & fold (make fillers at least 7" wide so the shop can cut & fold).
Note for End Panels: "band 2w, 1h".
Top Mold, Light Rail: "band 1h" - each should be wider than its finish/install dimension so it can be cut & folded by the shop.
Toe Kick - order enough rips to cover total length (does not need banding).
